# Provenance: `vadd-floorplanned` golden case

## Design + HLS inputs

`design.json` and `inputs/*.v` are byte copies of the `vadd` case (see that
case's `PROVENANCE.md`). Unlike the synthesis flow, the CLI *floorplan*
flow flattens the graph (`tapa_ir::flatten`) before codegen, so the golden
harness does the same when a `floorplan.json` is present — the generated
top therefore names FIFOs in their flattened form (`a_q_VecAdd`, ...).

## Floorplan: produced by the real planner

`floorplan.json` is the verbatim, pretty-printed output of running
`tapa_floorplan::plan_with_inputs` on this design, regenerated by the
ignored probe test:

```sh
cd tapa-core && cargo test -p tapa-floorplan \
  --test golden_floorplan_probe -- --ignored --nocapture
```

The probe mirrors what `tapa floorplan` would build mid-flow
(`tapa-cli/src/steps/floorplan/mod.rs`):

- device `u280` (part `xcu280-fsvh2892-2L-e`, platform
  `xilinx_u280_gen3x16_xdma_1_202211_1`, required by external-memory
  floorplanning), `cbc` solver on `PATH`, threads = 1;
- one `MemoryInterface` per direct M-AXI endpoint with bank bindings a
  user would write in `--connectivity`: `a -> HBM[0]`, `b -> HBM[16]`,
  `c -> DDR[1]` (the varied anchoring is what spreads instances across
  slots and forces real cross-region routes);
- `ControlInterface { has_s_axi_control: true }`, matching the top's
  `s_axi_control` slave, so the planner routes the distributed-control
  bundles.

The chosen plan places `Mmap2Stream_0` in `SLOT_X0Y0` (with its HBM bank),
`Mmap2Stream_1` in `SLOT_X1Y0`, and `Add_0`, `Stream2Mmap_0`, the global
controller, and `control_s_axi_U` in `SLOT_X1Y1` (with the `DDR[1]` and
`S_AXI_CONTROL` tags). It pipelines 8 channels: streams `a_q_VecAdd`
(2 hops) and `b_q_VecAdd` (3 hops) with `Double` register schemes, and
`Launch`/`Reset`/`Completion` control bundles for both remote children.
The solve is deterministic (fixed CBC options + lexicographic
tie-break), so re-running the probe reproduces this file byte-for-byte.

Coverage note for Phase 1: the planner co-locates every direct M-AXI child
with its bank, so this plan contains no cross-region `Axi` routes — the
`axi_pipeline` insertion path is not exercised by this golden (it remains
unit-covered in `generate_rtl_tests.rs`). Distorting bank bindings to
manufacture an AXI crossing was rejected as fake provenance.

## Blessed output

Same rules as the `vadd` case: `expected/rtl/` = generated RTL
(support assets live under `_assets/`), normalized. The floorplanned path replaces the monolithic
FSM with distributed control (`tapa_control.v` hierarchy), so this case
does not emit `VecAdd_fsm.v`.
